scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Exact asymptotic moduli in a Daugavet subspace of L1” (preprints/Exact-asymptotic-moduli-in-a-Daugavet-subspace-of-L1-September-27-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 331 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 92b3cc3a790bb7fe), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let E be an infinite-dimensional closed real subspace of L1(Ω, P), where P is a probability measure. Suppose its closed unit ball is totally bounded for convergence in measure and its inherited norm has the Daugavet property. Then every x ∈ SE and t > 0 satisfy HE(x, t) = max{t/2, t − 1}, DE(x, t) = max{0, t − 2}. Consequently these are also the formulas for b δE(t) and δE(t). The space E admits no equivalent AUC norm.
